Overlaps: why are these overlapping in the first place? So that needs to be investigated, not accepted as a consequence of the method. It's a bug in design or implementation.

My inclination is to push through it. Imagine the layer as a single fully inelastic ball; this simple model shows things like the period doubling and allows you to estimate how hard the collisions will be to the plate. If based on that we feel like we're entering a long phase, we can still push through it I bet.

A long hold is meh because you have to ramp to it or you are not really measuring hysteresis. A better plan would be an unfixed rate where we just sit and wait until we achieve some statistical hold and then we go up/down however much. Stopping rule is fine.
We are moving to hatteras tonight so diskspace is not a problem. We don't need every ball's trajectory. We need to be able to evaluate bulk quantities. And we want to be able to restart a run.
Since we're going on hatteras, which has plenty of cores, let's unpause everything as well.
